phase_6_cases.name: UPI Fake Job Scam
phase_6_cases.narrative: I joined a Telegram group where someone promised me a software job. They asked me to pay ₹8,000 as a registration fee through UPI. I sent the money and shared my Aadhaar number and bank account details. After that they blocked me.

expected.fraud_category: Fake Job Offer & Registration Fee Extortion
expected.primary_pathway: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal & Emergency Helpline 1930

phase_6_cases.name: Fake E-Commerce Seller
phase_6_cases.narrative: On September 5, 2026, I purchased a camera online for $450 via debit card. I received an order receipt and tracking number showing delivered to a different state. The merchant never shipped the item and stopped responding.

phase_6_cases.name: Deceptive Subscription Trap
phase_6_cases.narrative: I signed up for a $1 trial of an online service. They automatically enrolled me into a $99/month recurring plan without clear disclosure and hid the cancellation button.

expected.fraud_category: Algorithmic Dark Pattern & Hidden Subscription Loophole

phase_6_cases.name: Unseen Freelance Gaming Item Scam
phase_6_cases.narrative: A seller on a gaming forum offered an exclusive digital item. After I transferred ₹12,000 via Net Banking, the seller deleted their profile and disappeared without sending the activation code.

expected.primary_pathway: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal & Emergency Helpline 1930

phase_6_cases.name: Completely Benign Non-Fraud Narrative
phase_6_cases.narrative: I went to the library yesterday and borrowed two books.
